diagrams.title: 重みを固定した三つの説明
objects: 既存A B ... Aのラベル

stages.label: 重みは固定
stages.state: 例と新入力が文脈に入り、同じモデルから出力。重み更新の経路はない。
stages.motion: 文脈カードが追加されるが重み枠は静止。

stages.label: ベイズ的な仮説
stages.state: 例→タスクの事後分布→出力の周辺化を原式の項に結ぶ。仮説と明記。
stages.motion: theta候補の強調が変わり、積分項へ合流。

stages.label: 学習則の模倣
stages.state: 順伝播の内部計算が学習アルゴリズムに似るという限定的な研究解釈。推論で重みを書き換えない。
stages.motion: 表現内部の状態だけを更新し固定重みを保持。

stages.label: 誘導ヘッド
stages.state: 本文のA B ... AからBへのコピー経路と、入力例→順伝播内の状態更新→出力という学習則模倣の仮説経路を並べる。状態更新は内部表現に限定し、モデル重みは固定。仮説名だけの見出しへ省略しない。
stages.motion: 前のA/Bから後のAを経て出力Bへ経路を追う。
requiredVisible: 入力例→順伝播内の状態更新→出力の経路を、誘導ヘッドのコピー経路と並べて残す
状態更新に学習則の模倣仮説というラベルを付ける
更新対象は内部表現であり、モデル重みは固定のままと示す
両者は候補仮説であり、見出しだけに省略しない

stages.label: 相補的な候補
stages.state: 3仮説を同じ入力/出力枠へ並列接続。排他的選択や決着の印は付けない。
stages.motion: 3経路が同じモデル枠の異なる観点として揃う。

checks: 仮説を確定機構にしない
誘導ヘッドを全ICLの証明にしない
thetaを学習済み重みthetaと混同しない

diagrams.title: 例の形式・数・順序を分けて比べる
objects: 形式/ラベル空間/分布タグ

stages.label: 何を示す例か
stages.state: 例列に形式・ラベル空間・入力分布のタグを付け、出力ラベルの正しさと区別。
stages.motion: 同じ例の別の属性を順に強調。

stages.label: 数と順序
stages.state: 同じ例IDの順序変更と例数変更を別条件にする。ラベル破壊の研究は条件依存として小ラベルで残す。
stages.motion: 順序ではカードを移動、例数では末尾を加減。混ぜない。

stages.label: 評価で確認
stages.state: 元条件・変更条件を同じ評価欄へ接続。増量の単調な改善や誤ラベル推奨の表示はしない。
stages.motion: 変更軸を固定した比較行を揃える。

checks: ラベルが常に不要とは示さない

diagrams.title: 記憶・汎化・汚染を分ける
objects: 時間軸/規模軸の明示切替

stages.label: 二つの評価
stages.state: 学習で見たデータと未見データを別枠にする。
stages.motion: 同じモデルから二つの評価先へ分岐。

stages.label: 逐語記憶
stages.state: 訓練データと出力の一致を強調し、汎化への等号を付けない。
stages.motion: 同じ記号IDが出力へ現れる対応線。

stages.label: 異なる現象
stages.state: 逐語記憶・grokking・二重降下を三つの小枠で同時に可読化。時間と規模の軸を混同しない。
stages.motion: 時間枠は遅れて変化、規模枠は非単調という質的形だけ。実測値なし。
requiredVisible: 訓練データと出力の同じ記号IDの一致線を逐語記憶の小枠に残す
未見データへの汎化とは別枠とし、記憶=汎化の等号を付けない
grokkingの時間軸と二重降下の規模軸を区別したまま並べる

stages.label: 訓練改善と汎化
stages.state: 訓練指標からテスト成功へ直接の保証線がないことを表示。
stages.motion: 2評価の間の未保証表示を残す。

stages.label: 汚染
stages.state: 評価データが訓練集合へ混入する重複と、非公開/新しい評価を別に配置。完全無汚染の保証印は付けない。
stages.motion: 一部評価カードが訓練領域と重なり、独立評価側を強調。

topics.heading: 概要: 重みを変えずに「学ぶ」ように見える
topics.topic: 文脈内学習とは、プロンプトに数個の例(入力 → 出力)を並べるだけで、モデルがそのパターンに従って新しい入力を処理する現象です(GPT-3 で顕著に示されました)。重みは 1 ミリも更新されていないのに「例から学んだ」ように振る舞うため、その仕組みは活発な研究対象です。実務の few-shot(プロンプトエンジニアリングの基礎技法)はこの現象の応用です。
topics.topicAfterCorrectionsCandidate: 文脈内学習とは、プロンプトに数個の例(入力 → 出力)を並べるだけで、モデルがそのパターンに従って新しい入力を処理する現象です(GPT-3 で顕著に示されました)。重みは 1 ミリも更新されていないのに「例から学んだ」ように振る舞うため、その仕組みは活発な研究対象です。実務の few-shot(プロンプトエンジニアリングの基礎技法)はこの現象の応用です。

topics.topic: 有力な仮説がいくつかあり、互いに排他的ではなく、相補的に真実の一部を捉えていると見られています。

topics.heading: ICL はなぜ起きるか: 主要な理論仮説
topics.topic: 暗黙のベイズ推定: 事前学習で多様な「タスク」を含む文書を学んだモデルが、プロンプトの例からどのタスク(潜在概念)かを推論し、それに沿って続きを生成しているという見方。式で書くと、出力は潜在タスク \theta について周辺化した形になります。

topics.heading: ICL はなぜ起きるか: 主要な理論仮説
topics.topic: メタ学習 / 学習アルゴリズムの模倣: Transformer の順伝播が、内部で勾配降下のような学習アルゴリズムを近似的に実行しているという見方。線形回帰のような単純なタスクで、ICL が最小二乗解に近づく挙動が示されています

topics.heading: ICL はなぜ起きるか: 主要な理論仮説
topics.topic: 誘導ヘッド(induction heads): 「直前に出た A B というパターンを見つけ、次に A が来たら B を続ける」というコピー機構を担う注意ヘッド。学習の途中で誘導ヘッドが形成される時期と ICL 能力の立ち上がりが対応することが観察され、ICL の機構的な担い手の候補とされています(→ LLM の解釈可能性の基礎)

topics.heading: few-shot の例の効き方
topics.topic: 形式・分布が、ラベルの正しさより効くことがある: few-shot 例のラベルをランダムに壊しても性能があまり落ちない場合がある、という報告があります。例は「正解を教える」より、出力の形式・ラベル空間・入力分布を示す役割が大きい、という解釈です(タスクや設定に依存し、常にそうとは限りません)

topics.heading: 記憶と汎化
topics.topic: モデルは「覚える」と「一般化する」の両方をします。その境界に関する現象を 3 つ。
topics.topicAfterCorrectionsCandidate: モデルは「覚える」と「一般化する」の両方をします。その境界に関する現象を 3 つ。

topics.heading: 記憶と汎化
topics.topic: 逐語記憶(memorization): 学習データの一部をそのまま暗記することがあります。頻出する・重複するデータほど記憶されやすく、大きいモデルほど記憶しやすい傾向が報告されています。これはプライバシー(学習データの漏出)と汚染の両面で問題になります
topics.topicAfterCorrectionsCandidate: 逐語記憶(memorization): 学習データの一部をそのまま暗記することがあります。頻出する・重複するデータほど記憶されやすく、大きいモデルほど記憶しやすい傾向が報告されています。これはプライバシー(学習データの漏出)と汚染の両面で問題になります

topics.heading: 記憶と汎化
topics.topic: grokking(遅れて訪れる汎化): 小さな課題で、訓練データを暗記した後、しばらくしてから急に汎化する現象。暗記と汎化が別の時間スケールで起きうることを示し、「訓練損失が下がった = 汎化した」ではないことの例証です
topics.topicAfterCorrectionsCandidate: grokking(遅れて訪れる汎化): 小さな課題で、訓練データを暗記した後、しばらくしてから急に汎化する現象。暗記と汎化が別の時間スケールで起きうることを示し、「訓練損失が下がった = 汎化した」ではないことの例証です

topics.heading: 記憶と汎化
topics.topic: 二重降下(double descent): モデルサイズやデータ量を増やすと、テスト誤差が「下がる → いったん上がる → 再び下がる」という非単調な曲線を描くことがある現象。「大きく/多くすれば単調に良くなる」という素朴な期待が成り立たない領域があることを示します
topics.topicAfterCorrectionsCandidate: 二重降下(double descent): モデルサイズやデータ量を増やすと、テスト誤差が「下がる → いったん上がる → 再び下がる」という非単調な曲線を描くことがある現象。「大きく/多くすれば単調に良くなる」という素朴な期待が成り立たない領域があることを示します

topics.heading: 記憶と汎化
topics.topic: 読み下すと: 「暗記と汎化は別物で、時間・規模に対して単純な関係ではない。訓練指標の改善を汎化と早合点しない」。

common.componentSignature: Named React component({children}); scene and controls use existing ReadingFigure.

proposedDispatcher.implementation: Fixed allowlist of three lazy named imports; unknown diagramId fails closed; root integration ownership.

sharedInterface.sceneBase: 640 x 430 viewBox by default; role=img with namespaced title/description IDs.
sharedInterface.wire: Existing Wire always supplies an arrowhead. Use plain SVG path without marker for nondirectional memorization correspondence; do not imply retrieval or causality.

modelContract.phase: Reuse clampPhase and stageForPhase. Finite numbers clamp into [0, stageCount-1]; stage=Math.round(clampedPhase). Nonfinite numbers and nonnumber phase, including null/undefined/string, throw TypeError.
modelContract.options: Plain object only, default {}. Null/array/nonplain and unknown keys rejected. Bad enums rejected. Strict unknown-key handling is proposed for E2, not claimed as all existing-model behavior.
modelContract.output: {phase,stage,label,detail,...semantic fields listed per diagram}; labels/detail/IDs/relationships correspond to rounded stage. Fractional phase only drives presentation motion.
modelContract.purity: Deterministic, no timers/network/randomness/state mutation; fresh nested output, frozen stage/fixture constants; caller cannot mutate future frames.
modelContract.stageConstants: Adopted labels/count/order exactly retained. Stage descriptions keep all adopted state/motion/checks and requiredVisible.
modelContract.ids: Semantic IDs stable; actual SVG/DOM id attributes namespace with renderScene.id for modal coexistence.
modelContract.numericPolicy: Only structural example counts and stage/phase exist as numbers. Probabilities, scores, loss/error/time/scale observations, performance gains, causal effect, turning points and optima remain null/unknown. SVG coordinates are drawing geometry, not observations.

common.controls: One optional custom Select in demonstrations only, two emphasis values. Both conditions stay visible without operation. No hypothesis winner control, curve slider, invented probabilities, retrieval mode, or accuracy calculator.
common.representation: Visible SVG labels and relationships plus accessible title/description. Data hooks expose visible semantic objects; hidden DOM is not acceptance. All READ carryovers work on a clean page without controls.
common.behavior: Reuse reading linkage, manual pause/step/replay/resume, keyboard, modal focus, reduced motion, no-JS and print. No always-running loop while paused/offscreen.
distinctions: ICL prompt-dependent internal representations are not optimizer updates of model weights.
Bayesian latent task theta is not model parameter W.
Induction-head context copying is a candidate mechanism, not evidence that all ICL is copying.
Prompt context copying is not an external database retrieval operation. The scope has no retrieval node; this does not claim ICL cannot be combined with retrieval.
Memorization is a training/output correspondence, not proof of an online database lookup or a causal intervention.
Fixed model weights apply to inference scenes; grokking across training progress may involve different model checkpoints.
Training performance does not guarantee held-out generalization; contamination overlap does not specify score inflation; private/recent evaluation does not guarantee cleanliness.

bayesTerms.label: p(出力 | θ, プロンプト)

stagePresentation.note: Only prompt/context changes; no weight-update arrow.
Use exact original integral meaning. Task candidate emphasis is qualitative; no finite probability distribution or winning-task choice.

stagePresentation.layout: Two full-width stacked lanes. Learning-rule route cannot shrink to a heading. Copy route shows five distinct occurrences and three typed relations.
Three compact parallel routes, all visible; no selection/decision/checkmark of settled mechanism.

hooks.visible: Stable context/model/output objects.
Each original formula term and latent-task label.
Full route and candidate label; detailed before/after boxes in stages 2/3.
Internal representations, not model parameters.
A B … A to B and separate occurrence-resolved relations.
全ICLの証明ではない
Three nonexclusive candidate paths.

mandatoryConclusions: Latent task theta and model parameters W are distinct.
Bayesian integration is a candidate explanation, not measured posterior data.
Learning-rule imitation only updates forward-pass internal representations in the schematic and carries a limited-research-setting qualification.
Induction A/B copy is one candidate, not all ICL or external retrieval.
The three hypotheses are not exclusive or settled.
proposed.carryoverGate: At unoperated READ stage 3, both full routes, fixed W and candidate limitations must remain visibly and accessibly readable.

fixture.cardContent: ID + 入力→出力 only. No added task, concrete data, answer label or prose example.
fixture.occurrenceIdRule: conditionId + "-" + exampleId; semantic exampleId is stable across all rows.
fixture.inputDistributionCaveat: The three attributes describe what examples can indicate. Removing an example changes the examples supplied; do not claim the observed empirical input distribution remains identical across count conditions.

controls.label: 強調する変更
controls.inactiveStageBehavior: Stage 0 effectiveComparisonFocus is null; selection cannot change semantic/visual frame at stage 0. Hide the inactive control; retain selection for stages 1/2.
controls.meaning: Emphasis only. Baseline, order and count rows remain visible concurrently without interaction.

stagePresentation.note: Emphasize existing attributes, not numerical effects. Optional control absent.
Order changes only permutation of the same set; count changes only trailing ex-3 membership. Motion confined to each comparison row.
Both change axes visible and separate. No invented score, diminishing-return curve or optimum.

hooks.visible: Three different attributes and their distinction from label correctness.
Stable labeled example cards, with occurrence IDs unique within scene.
All rows concurrently; chosen value controls emphasis only.
研究結果はタスク・設定に依存。誤ラベルを推奨しない。Use concise diagram labels, not additional prose blocks.
One shared evaluation-condition frame; no numerical outcome.

mandatoryConclusions: Examples communicate format, label space and input distribution as distinct attributes.
Label-corruption findings are task/setting dependent, not proof labels are always unnecessary or a recommendation to corrupt them.
Order comparison preserves the same example set.
Count comparison varies a trailing example independently from order.
No monotonic improvement, universally optimal ordering/count, fabricated score or empirical curve.
Changes require evaluation under a shared protocol.

fixture.checkpointScope: Two evaluation branches in one snapshot use the same checkpoint. Grokking along training progress does not keep weights fixed across all points.

phenomena.qualitativeRelation: 訓練での改善後、汎化が遅れて現れる場合

phenomena.otherConditions: Conceptual comparison with other conditions fixed; not claimed from empirical data.

stagePresentation.note: Correspondence has no causal/retrieval arrowhead and does not imply all outputs are memorized.

stagePresentation.layout: Upper full-width memorization strip; lower two distinct panels for time and scale. Three phenomena simultaneously readable. No selector hides a panel.
stagePresentation.note: SVG coordinates may draw qualitative shapes without numeric ticks or semantic sample values. These are schematic shapes, not results.
No direct success-guarantee arrow; no weights-fixed badge spanning training progress.
An explicit separate schematic scenario, not an assertion about the article benchmark or real data. No score inflation amount or guaranteed clean stamp.

hooks.visible: Training and unseen-evaluation references remain distinct.
Metric labels without empirical values.
Two identical symbol IDs joined by matching line, with separate heldout frame.
No equality of memorization and generalization.
All three phenomena with separate time and scale axes; qualitative shapes only.
Training improvement does not guarantee test success.
Shared symbol present in both schematic sets, no numerical performance effect.
Separate evaluation alternatives with no clean guarantee.

mandatoryConclusions: A matching training/output string is correspondence, not an online retrieval call or sufficient causal intervention.
Grokking uses a training-progress/time axis and remains a limited phenomenon, not the normal behavior of every LLM.
Double descent uses a model-scale axis in this schematic and remains conditional, not a measured curve or optimal scale.
Training improvement alone does not guarantee generalization.
Evaluation/training overlap can affect interpretation but provides no invented score increment.
Private/recent evaluation and contamination checks are measures, not absolute cleanliness guarantees.
proposed.carryoverGate: At unoperated READ stage 2, matching symbol ID and line, separate unseen-generalization reference, and both separately labeled time/scale axes must all remain visible and accessible.

independentAssertions.oraclePolicy: Independent author writes literal fixtures/assertions from adopted plan and reviewed interface. Do not import production model or derive expected values from rendered DOM. Structural identity/axis/relationship checks, not scientific performance validation.
unit: Reject invalid phase/options, clamp finite range and use shared rounding at each boundary.
Check all 13 stages and both traversal directions at each boundary + .49/.50/.51; output IDs/relations follow the same rounded stage.
Default/options deterministic; nested-frame mutation cannot modify later results/constants.
Stage 0 demonstrations ignores emphasis option; stage 1/2 both rows remain visible under either emphasis. Hypothesis/memory models accept no options.
Check no fabricated probability/accuracy/loss/time/scale/causal/optimal/performance values; structural counts are explicit exceptions.
Check inference fixed weights versus internal representations and training checkpoint scope.
Check immutable identities, order-set equality, tail-only count change, distinct occurrence IDs and source/target relationship types.
Check memorization/read carryover and both axes/limitations in stage-specific semantic output.
negativeMutations: Change .5 rounding or make labels use a different stage.
Change theta role to model weights or internal update to weight optimizer.
Remove manual-stage carryover route, replace by heading or hide it in DOM.
Change induction copy source occurrence or claim all ICL is proven.
Change order example set, remove a nontrailing count example or hide unselected comparison.
Swap time/scale axes or insert measured curve samples/numeric turning points.
Use a retrieval/causal arrow for memorization or equate it with generalization.
Invent numeric quality/score gain or add clean/private guarantee.
ast: Reparse exact original article and match SHA, headings, block types/groups and all three source digests.
Apply approved wrappers and remove them; canonical original AST, formula, inline math/code, lists, links, heading order and block order remain identical.
Maintain 8 H3, 5 wrapped H3/15 body blocks, 1 display math, 2 inline math, 3 inline code, 0 fenced code and 0 Mermaid.
Check dispatcher/registry/MDX allowlists and lazy-chunk ownership fail closed; no E2 registration in this preparation.
browser: Each 13-stage state with visible relationships/text and semantic hooks, normal click/keyboard without force.
All 11 READ stops forward/reverse. Carryovers at hypotheses READ3 and memory READ2 on fresh page by scrolling only; no selector, step, playback or modal first.
Demonstrations selector order/count at active stages, inactive stage0 no effect; figure-local state independent of other scenes.
Play/pause/replay, read resume, modal/focus return, reduced motion, noJS/print retain required meaning.

Viewport and complete-scene screenshots are separately labeled. At minimum existing acceptance profiles 1440 light/dark, 1280x720 light, 390 light/dark, 960x540 DSF2 plus current required large/tablet profiles.
Inspect actual visible SVG labels/lines and geometric overlap, not only data attributes. Verify desktop readable size without requiring fullscreen for READ meaning.
independence: Proposal author does not self-approve this interface or later own scene implementation.
Independent scene/content review after implementation; independent public oracle from adopted semantics.
Local and public evidence are separate; same assertions and source identity required. No present product, browser, CI or public acceptance claimed.

performed: Read adopted E2 plan and original article.
Recomputed original SHA and all three source digests against installed remark parser and current registry helper.
Recorded AST inventory and per-heading block types/groups; no source correction proposed.
Inspected existing ReadingFigure, concept primitives, reading clock and pretraining conventions.
preparationVerification.handoff: Review this interface independently; resolve its proposed fields; freeze exports/hooks/options with scene/root/public-fixture owners only when E2 starts after E1/C2 prerequisites. This is not a kit case-registration change.

consistencyCheck.evidenceClass: read-only source/proposal consistency, not model/unit/browser/build/CI/public acceptance
